title: Pork and Peppered Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender pork and a variety of spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, brown the pork on all sides over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are slightly tender.
Add the peppered stew seasoning, Egyptian paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
